fields.reasoning: The question says the transcript persists on disk, and the Claude adapter already starts each session with a stored --session-id (claudecode.go:57). Resuming that session keeps the agent's context and the work it already committed, so the run does not redo finished steps. A fresh session would lose that context and need a re-briefing. The fresh-session fallback covers the case where the transcript is gone. Nothing in the adapter needs a new ID scheme for this.
fields.statement: Resume a usage-limited run by continuing the same agent session with the Claude CLI's resume flag, keyed on the session ID the run already stores; start a fresh session only when the transcript is missing
